mapper.sql: select id, user_id, scene, model, template_id, prompt, response, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status, error_msg, response_time, call_time, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from audit_ai_call_log
mapper.insert: insert into audit_ai_call_log ( user_id, scene, model, template_id, prompt, response, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status, error_msg, response_time, call_time, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{scene}, #{model}, #{templateId}, #{prompt}, #{response}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, #{responseTime}, #{callTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete:
delete from audit_ai_call_log where id in

mapper.select: select scene, model, count(*) as call_count, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, avg(response_time) as avg_response_time from audit_ai_call_log where user_id = #{userId} and call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by scene, model order by call_count desc

select date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as call_date, count(*) as call_count, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, avg(response_time) as avg_response_time from audit_ai_call_log where scene = #{scene} and call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by call_date desc

select scene, count(*) as call_count, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, avg(response_time) as avg_response_time from audit_ai_call_log where model = #{model} and call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by scene order by call_count desc

select scene, model, count(*) as call_count, sum(prompt_tokens) as total_prompt_tokens, sum(completion_tokens) as total_completion_tokens, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, avg(response_time) as avg_response_time from audit_ai_call_log
AND user_id = #{userId}
AND date_format(call_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
AND date_format(call_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y%m%d')
group by scene, model order by total_tokens desc
mapper.delete: delete from audit_ai_call_log where call_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
mapper.select: select model, count(*) as call_count, sum(total_tokens) as total_tokens, sum(prompt_tokens) as total_prompt_tokens, sum(completion_tokens) as total_completion_tokens, avg(response_time) as avg_response_time, max(call_time) as last_call_time from audit_ai_call_log where status = 1 group by model order by call_count desc
select count(*) from audit_ai_call_log where model = #{model} and status = 1
